comparison.objective: Perform the pull-wipe-reseat-pull-read-reseat dipstick procedure and record oil level; candidate iteratively tunes damping response.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-part extraction/insertion, wiping, visual reading, and card marking versus recessed hex access, fine collar adjustment, and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Correct procedural history, valid second reading, recorded level, and restored dipstick/tools versus measured stopping performance and setting retention.
comparison.reason: Both use an iterative procedure, but the dipstick task tests contamination-clearing and measurement, not mechanical response adjustment.
